canonical_project: Digital CASA / Kyrgyz government traffic exchange and data center plan for Osh
owner: Government of the Kyrgyz Republic / World Bank Digital CASA program
notes: Kabar reported in 2017 that the Digital CASA project would build fiber and three powerful traffic exchange centers, named as Bishkek, Osh and a data center, with about $10 million for the data center component. AKIpress later reported a presidential goal to build one data center in each Kyrgyz region at a forum in Osh. No public evidence found that an Osh physical data center was completed; status kept planned and capacity unknown.
